skew.text: Investors are paying up for downside cover.

iv_rv.text: Protection costs about 3.5 points more than recent moves justify.

term.text: That is the normal shape. No near-term event is being priced in.

gauge.text: 74th percentile of a calm two years, so "expensive" here is relative. Six months ago it sat in the typical band.
